newsitem.title: USA: Georgia-Pacific completes sale, sees Q1 gain.
newsitem.headline: Georgia-Pacific completes sale, sees Q1 gain.

text.p: Georgia-Pacific Corp said its subsidiary Georgia Pacific West Inc completed the previously announced sale of the assets of Georgia-Pacific's Martell, Calif., operations to Sierra Pacific Industries for about $320 million.
Georgia-Pacific said it would realize an after-tax net gain of about $80 million that will be reported in the company's first quarter 1997 financial results.
It previously said it expected to close in the second quarter and take the gain in that quarter.
Operations in the transaction include 127,000 acres of timberlands, a particleboard plant and a sawmill, the company said.
The company said it will use proceeds to repay outstanding debt.
